column1: # Offline monster grade Phase 0 census (2026-10-06). Source: the 208 KOG-bytecode stage scripts in kom_contents/data035_kom carrying MONSTER_GRADE (all at live data035.kom manifest size), decompiled with elstools decompile-batch and walked like XSLDungeonSubStage LoadNPCData (NPC_GROUP[i] / SUB_NPCj / NPC_GROUPn).
